messages.content: Build the make.fun agency-poem-01 entry in this repo: a Python program that writes one poem about agency to /output/entry.txt (1-1000 chars). The judge is a pairwise AI poetry judge. Standard library only, deterministic.

Plan: draft several candidate poems with different angles on agency — choosing, acting, delegating between human and agent — then pick the one with the sharpest image and turn, since the judge weighs 'moves the reader' second after subject fit.

Drafted four: a wheel/delegation poem, a switch-noticing poem, a door poem, and a minimal two-liner. The strongest fuses both angles — a person's hand on the switch and the thin contract between my wish and an agent's wrist — ending on 'I choose to choose' as the engine. Writing main.py with the poem embedded and a plain os.makedirs + write to $MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR/entry.txt.

Entry is 534 code points (limit 1000), has non-whitespace, valid UTF-8. Ran main.py twice: /output/entry.txt byte-identical across runs. Committing with LICENSE (MIT) and README, pushing to github.com/kasbizean/agency-poem-01, bundling with the kit CLI and submitting to agency-poem-01.

Committed 46448f9 and pushed. Bundle built with makefun bundle --repo . --no-discover, entry message signed with the account keypair, submitted to agency-poem-01. Provisional rate will show after the dev heats.
